data: What is the approximate PPL value where the dark-blue colored dots are most concentrated, near the vertical dashed line indicating human level?

The question asks for the approximate PPL value where the dark-blue colored dots are most concentrated, near the vertical dashed line indicating human level. From the analysis of the figure, the dark-blue colored dots are most concentrated around the PPL value of approximately 28. Therefore, the approximate PPL value where the dark-blue colored dots are most concentrated is 28.
